_comment: Real size of each piece, used to scale models for AR (1 unit = 1 m). Give heightCm when the brand confirms the exact total height. Until then sizes come from a seat height of 50 cm (upholstered armchairs: 45–50) and a 48 cm ottoman, so pieces read at full natural size in AR. Preview with `node scripts/analyze-models.mjs`, then `npm run optimize`.
